items.title: Robert Glasper interviewed by Greg Thomas, Clinton, New York, February 20, 2016
items.q: And Kendrick’s like doing a poem over it and we’re swinging and like going in.

ctx.x: And so the first thing, Terrace is like, this first tune I want you to sound like McCoy Tyner. You know? It was a song called “For Free.” And Kendrick’s like doing a poem over it and we’re swinging and like going in. You know what I mean?
